description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for handling custom route configurations in Next.js, including redirects, rewrites, and headers. It includes validation, normalization, and processing of route objects, and loads route configurations asynchronously.

methods.name: getRedirectStatus
methods.description: Returns the appropriate HTTP status code for a redirect based on route properties.

methods.name: normalizeRouteRegex
methods.description: Removes unnecessary escaping from route regex source.

methods.name: checkRedirect
methods.description: Validates a redirect object, checking for valid status code and 'permanent' flag.

methods.name: checkHeader
methods.description: Validates a header object, ensuring headers array and key/value types are correct.

methods.name: tryParsePath
methods.description: Attempts to parse a route path into tokens, handling URL parsing if needed, and reports errors.

methods.name: checkCustomRoutes
methods.description: Validates an array of route objects (redirects, rewrites, headers) for correctness and consistency.

methods.name: processRoutes
methods.description: Processes and adjusts route objects based on internationalization and basePath configurations.

methods.name: loadRedirects
methods.description: Loads and validates redirect configurations asynchronously.

methods.name: loadRewrites
methods.description: Loads and validates rewrite configurations asynchronously.

methods.name: loadHeaders
methods.description: Loads and validates header configurations asynchronously.

methods.name: loadCustomRoutes
methods.description: Main function that loads headers, rewrites, and redirects concurrently, applies additional redirects based on trailingSlash and basePath, and returns the assembled route configuration.
